name: GraphHopper
description: GraphHopper is a high-performance, German-developed open-source routing engine based on OpenStreetMap data; it serves as the technological core of the federal routing service operated by the BKG and powers numerous regional mobility portals. Municipalities benefit from an extremely fast, vendor-independent solution for optimizing specialized services—such as winter maintenance and waste management—that integrates seamlessly into existing geographic information systems (GIS).
